reference: four independent frames in wide mode
roundtrip: timed comparator asserts equality for both codecs; standalone CLI size and full restoration checked separately
timing: in-memory median per codec; wall throughput based on original bytes; includes worker startup, excludes file I/O
criteria: bytes strictly smaller; median encode time strictly lower; decode throughput >= 0.95 times zstd
dataset_scope: All 25 published Squash datasets other than the original enwik8, x-ray and mozilla
tolerance_unit: per file and level, not the corpus aggregate
